# symbolicMassMatrixDerivativeTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicMassMatrixDerivativeTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicMassMatrixDerivativeTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The effect of the derivative of M(q) q_tt by q on Newton's method (#3228). The Newton Jacobians of
#           Exudyn have the mass matrix, but not this term, which is zero for a constant mass matrix and not for
#           rigid bodies on Tait-Bryan angles. Three such bodies, spinning fast about a tilted axis, on spring-dampers
#           to the ground and to each other, built with exudyn.symbolics.userItems.UserItemCreator and recorded, as
#           SymbolicSystem: exudyn.symbolics.solvers.SolveGeneralizedAlpha with full Newton takes the exact
#           Jacobian of the system, and once the Jacobian without the term, as Exudyn has it; mbs.SolveDynamic for
#           comparison. All three give the same solution; the Newton iterations show the effect.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-02
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.symbolics.systemModel import SymbolicSystem
from exudyn.symbolics.solvers import SolveGeneralizedAlpha
import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse

class JacobianWithoutMassMatrixDerivative:
    """the system with the Jacobian of the residual M q_tt - f without d(M q_tt)/dq: the derivative by q at q_tt minus
    the one at q_tt = 0, as f does not depend on q_tt"""
    def __init__(self, system):
        self.system = system
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self.system, name)
    def ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(self, q=None, q_t=None, q_tt=None, t=0., factor_q=1., factor_q_t=0., factor_q_tt=0., sparse=False, **kwargs):
        J = self.system.ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(q, q_t, q_tt, t, factor_q=factor_q, factor_q_t=factor_q_t, factor_q_tt=factor_q_tt)
        J_q = self.system.ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(q, q_t, q_tt, t, factor_q=factor_q)
        J_q0 = self.system.ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(q, q_t, np.zeros(len(q_tt)), t, factor_q=factor_q)
        J = np.asarray(J) - (np.asarray(J_q) - np.asarray(J_q0))
        return scipy.sparse.csr_matrix(J) if sparse else J

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()
creator = UserItemCreator(mbs)
ground = creator.CreateGround()
inertia = InertiaCuboid(density=1000, sideLengths=[0.3, 0.1, 0.05])
previous = ground
for i in range(3):
    body = creator.CreateRigidBody(referencePosition=[0.4*(i + 1), 0, 0], initialAngularVelocity=[20, 5, 30],
                                   inertia=inertia, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0], nodeType=exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz)
    creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[previous, body], localPosition0=[0.4*i if i == 0 else 0.15, 0, 0],
                               localPosition1=[-0.15, 0, 0], stiffness=1e4, damping=5)
    previous = body
creator.Record()
mbs.Assemble()
system = SymbolicSystem(mbs)

simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.2
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.useModifiedNewton = False
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-10
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.generalizedAlpha.spectralRadius = 0.8
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False

exact = SolveGeneralizedAlpha(system, simulationSettings)
without = SolveGeneralizedAlpha(JacobianWithoutMassMatrixDerivative(system), simulationSettings)
mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings, solverType=exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha)
qExudyn = np.array(mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates())
iterationsExudyn = mbs.sys['dynamicSolver'].it.newtonStepsCount

scale = np.max(np.abs(exact['q'][-1]))
differenceWithout = np.max(np.abs(without['q'][-1] - exact['q'][-1]))/scale
differenceExudyn = np.max(np.abs(qExudyn - exact['q'][-1]))/scale
exu.Print('Newton iterations: exact Jacobian', exact['newtonIterations'], ', without d(M q_tt)/dq', without['newtonIterations'],
          ', SolveDynamic', iterationsExudyn)
exu.Print('relative difference of q to the exact Jacobian: without the term', differenceWithout, ', SolveDynamic', differenceExudyn)

u = 1 + int(differenceWithout > 1e-7) + int(differenceExudyn > 1e-7) + int(exact['newtonIterations'] > without['newtonIterations'])
exu.Print('solution of symbolicMassMatrixDerivativeTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
